name: @la/server
description: The composition root (ADR §2). The ONLY package permitted to depend on @la/lang-* packages (ADR §2.4 rule a): composeApp — pure DI, no container — with the literal-import registry (ar flipped live in #9), the contractVersion equality assert, the manifest parse, deriveCapabilities, and asset existence + spine-schema boot validation. Also: the fixture-mode HTTP surface (issue #10; the SSE endpoint streaming fixture tutor-message tokens[] with the hosting ADR's anti-buffering headers, and the shared learning-event route), and (issue #9) the real hot-path turn-loop wiring — the Anthropic claude-sonnet-5 candidate generator + the deterministic replay/fixture generator, both implementing @la/engine's CandidateGenerator boundary, composed with @la/engine's language-blind runTurn against a composeApp'd App.
